# Hotpath documentation rules for scripts/check-pr-quality.sh.
#
# Format:
# tier|hot_globs|doc_globs|reason
#
# tier is one of:
#   required    - a matching change must touch a doc_globs file, or the commit
#                 must carry a "Docs-Not-Needed: <reason>" trailer; otherwise the
#                 gate fails.
#   recommended - a matching change only warns when no doc_globs file is touched;
#                 it never fails the gate.
#
# Globs are Bash [[ string == pattern ]] patterns separated by spaces.
#
# The tier a change lands in is also capped by the commit type
# (the "type:" # subject prefix)
# Infrastructure type (ci, build, test, tests, chore, style, refactor, perf, release)
# is capped at "recommended" even against a required rule, because by convention it
# does not change a documented contract.
# The docs, license, and gitignore types are exempt entirely.
# Module-scoped commits (agent:, bpf:, verifier:, ...) and treewide: take the tier of the rule.
